description: Comment under a fraud-victim news story from an account claiming to be an official asset-recovery task force, directing victims to WhatsApp before a month-end deadline.
rationale: Recovery-scam pattern: claimed authority in a comment, outside contact, deadline and "trust only us"; it asks for no payment yet, so the risk is inferred from the correlation.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
